title: Timber joins the CSAF Godot Collection: now 22 addon packs
html:
Timber is now part of the CSAF Godot Collection, version 1.1.0. If you own the collection, the new file is on your download page now, at no extra cost. It holds all 22 of our paid Godot 4.7 addon packs in one project, 1,175 presets for 2D games.

What joined

Timber: choppable trees cut from your own TileMapLayer, 48 fell styles. 48 presets. Its addon folder in the collection is the same files as its own download, and its demo opens from the browser like every other pack.

Also in this version

  • The browser keeps three rows of cards and widens by a column when a pack joins, so no card shrinks and each picture is cropped to its card instead of stretched.
  • The Readme now carries the one measured limit under Compatibility that the store page already named, with the project setting that moves it.

Every preset of all 22 packs was photographed again under Forward+ and Compatibility on the shipped bytes, 2,352 frames, with no engine error line.

The CSAF Godot Collection is $19.99. Timber alone is $9.99.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, and the demo art comes from our own generated sets.
